blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Scientific abstracts mix contributions with background, motivation, and
meta-language, so tools that read them as-is cannot separate what a field produces from what it discusses . We present Drift
Inspector , an open-source system for measuring and exploring how a research
field changes over time at the level of Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs) :
decontextualized, contribution-bearing propositions an LLM extracts
from each abstract before analysis. The system clusters these
claims across years into an interactive map where every trend traces back
to the claims and papers behind it. Applied to six years
of EMNLP, it shows the field shifting away from classic NLP tasks toward
LLM-era capabilities such as reasoning and multimodality — a movement
that keyword or whole-abstract counts blur. The released data extend beyond EMNLP:
the same pipeline has processed the full ACL Anthology (346k claims, 80k
abstracts, 423 venues). Extraction is human-validated and
clustering checked against an external manually constructed taxonomy. 1 1 1 A live demo, code and data are available at: https://hamyrappy.github.io/drift-inspector .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Major NLP venues, such as ACL or EMNLP, publish thousands of papers released every few months — far beyond what anyone can read. This is due to recent acceleration in AI development, firstly attracting more interest to the field, but also because the research itself, including paper writing, now can be automated with LLMs and agents. As a result, the number of published papers has a trend on sharp increase every year. A similar situation is observed in most large AI-related conferences beyond NLP, such as NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, etc.
blocks.zh: NLP的主要地点,如ACL或EMNLP,每几个月发表数千篇论文——远远超出了任何人都能读到的. 这是由于最近AI开发的加速,首先吸引了该领域更多的兴趣,但也因为研究本身,包括纸质写作,现在可以自动化与LLMS和代理. 因此,出版的论文数量每年都有急剧增加的趋势. 在NLP以外的大多数大型AI相关会议中也观察到类似的情况,如NeurIPS,ICLR,CVPR等.

blocks.en: This urges development of tools for automatic summarization and effective and efficient exploration of this tsunami of research contributions. Besides, to understand how a research field evolves, one needs to know what its papers contribute, not only what they talk about. In rapidly moving fields like NLP the two diverge: an old thread may still saturate the motivation of papers that now advance other topics, while a new direction may appear only in contribution statements.
blocks.zh: 这就要求开发各种工具,以便自动归纳和有效和高效地探索这场海啸的研究贡献。 此外,为了了解研究领域是如何演变的,人们需要知道其论文的贡献,而不仅仅是他们谈论的内容. 在像NLP这样的迅速移动的字段中,两者是不同的:一条旧线条仍然可能饱和现在推进其他专题的论文的动机,而一个新的方向可能只出现在贡献说明中。

blocks.en: Existing literature exploration systems do not make this distinction. For instance, NLP Scholar ( Mohammad, 2020 ) , NLPExplorer ( Parmar et al., 2020 ) , and CL Scholar ( Singh et al., 2018 ) index papers, venues, authors, and term frequencies; topic-model dashboards built on LDA or BERTopic ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) operate on raw abstract text. So in existing systems, usually, the word “parsing” would count the same whether it appears in the motivation of an LLM reasoning paper or in the actual contribution of a dependency parsing paper.
blocks.zh: 现有的文献勘探系统没有作出这种区分。 例如,NLP学者(Mohammad,2020年),NLPExplorer(Parmar等人,2020年),以及CL学者(Singh等人,2018年)索引文件、地点、作者和术语频率;基于LDA或BERTOPIC(Grootendorst,2022年)的专题模型仪表板以原始抽象文本运行。 因此,在现有的系统中,无论是在LLM推理文件的动机中,还是在依赖解析文件的实际贡献中,“解析”一词通常都算数相同。

blocks.en:
Drift Inspector , the system presented in this paper, aims to address this gap. Its pipeline first maps each abstract into a small set of Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs) — self-contained, falsifiable propositions about what the paper contributes, stripped of motivation, prior-work framing, and meta-language.
Extraction acts as an analytic lens: it fixes what kind of information enters every downstream statistic. We then embed the claims with SPECTER2, cluster them jointly across years, and aggregate them into per-cluster prevalence trajectories.
The result is served as a web application with linked views: an interactive claim map (year filters, drift coloring), cluster trend pages, side-by-side comparison of cohorts — conferences, authors, keyword subsamples (Figure 3 ); every aggregate traces back to the claims and source papers.
blocks.zh:
本文件中介绍的“流动检查员”制度旨在弥补这一差距。 它的管道首先将每个抽象地绘制成一套小的原子贡献索赔(ACCs)——关于论文的贡献的自成一体的、可伪造的命题,失去动机、前期工作框架和元语言。
采掘是一种分析透镜:它固定了何种信息进入每一个下游的统计数据。 然后,我们把索赔与SPECTER2合并成若干年,合并成每个组群的流行轨迹。
其结果是作为具有链接视图的网络应用程序:交互式索赔地图(年滤镜、漂流色),集群趋势页,分组-会议、作者、关键词子样本(图3)的侧面比较;所有索赔和源文件的汇总跟踪。

blocks.en: The system is aimed at three audiences: (i) researchers positioning new work or writing surveys, who need to see how a topic evolved and what replaced it; (ii) conference organizers or area chairs , who need evidence of topical shifts across conference years; and (iii) science-of-science researchers , who get a validated, reusable extraction pipeline.

blocks.en: 2.1 Literature exploration systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 文学探索系统

blocks.en:
NLP Scholar ( Mohammad, 2020 ) provides interactive dashboards over ACL Anthology metadata and term frequencies; NLPExplorer ( Parmar et al., 2020 ) and CL Scholar ( Singh et al., 2018 ) index papers, fields, and citation structure. These systems operate at the topic or keyword level.
More recent systems include NLP-KG Schopf and Matthes (2024) , GenGo Takeshita et al. (2024) , and GenGo Ultra Takeshita et al. (2025) . Various surveys of NLP as a field have also been conducted, e.g. Schopf et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
NLP学者(Mohammad,2020年)在ACL人类学元数据和术语频率上提供互动的仪表板;NLPexulatrer(Parmar等人,2020年)和CL学者(Singh等人,2018年)索引文件,字段,以及引用结构. 这些系统以专题或关键词级别运作。
较近期的系统包括NLP-KG Schopf和Matthes(2024年),GenGo Takeshita等人(2024年),以及GenGo Ultra Takeshita等人(2025年). 还对NLP作为一个领域进行了各种调查,例如: Schopf等人(2023年).

blocks.en: Drift Inspector differs in its unit of analysis, extracting atomic contribution claims , distinguishing what papers contribute from what they mention. As a tool it also adds a drift-color overlay that turns the claim map into a field-level trend heatmap, claim-to-paper traceability from every aggregate, side-by-side cohort comparison (venues, authors, keyword-defined subsamples), and a corpus-agnostic single-file deploy that these corpus-tied dashboards do not offer.
blocks.zh: 漂流检查员的分析单位不同,提取原子贡献主张,将论文的贡献与它们所提到的区别开来. 作为一种工具,它还增加了漂移颜色的叠加,将索赔图变成实地一级的趋势热图,从每个总数中进行索赔到文件的可追溯性,并逐组比较(视频、作者、关键词定义的子样本),以及这些实体标本仪表板不提供的生物体不可知的单一文件。

blocks.en: 2.2 Diachronic analyses of NLP
blocks.zh: 2.2 NLP的二亚慢性分析

blocks.en: Prior work tracks task/method prevalence ( Uban et al., 2021 ) , idea co-occurrence ( Tan et al., 2017 ) , rhetorical framing ( Prabhakaran et al., 2016 ) , and causal paradigm shifts ( Pramanick et al., 2023 ) . Closest is Pramanick et al. (2025) , which classifies contribution statements into a fixed taxonomy. Our system instead lets contribution clusters emerge bottom-up and packages the whole measurement loop — extraction, validation, clustering, statistics, visualization — into a reusable tool.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作跟踪任务/方法普及率 (Uban等人,2021年),思想共化(Tan等人,2017年),辞典框架(Prabhakaran等人,2016年),以及因果范式转变(Pramanick等人,2023年). Closest是Pramanick等人(2025年),将贡献表分类为固定分类. 我们的系统让贡献集群从下而上出现,并将整个测量循环——提取,验证,集群,统计,可视化——包成一个可重复使用的工具.

blocks.en: 2.3 Atomic semantic units
blocks.zh: 2.3 原子语义单元

blocks.en: Claim-level decomposition follows the atomization principle of FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) and Atomic Content Units ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , used there for factuality and summarization evaluation. Idea-atom decompositions have also been used to sample novel research directions ( Artiles et al., 2026 ) . We repurpose atomization for scientometric measurement. ACCs are units of field-level counting, so we check them against their own abstracts and leave their truth to the source paper.
blocks.zh: 索赔层次的分解遵循FActScore(Min等人,2023年)和原子内容单位(Liu等人,2023年)的原子分解原则,用于事实和总结评价。 Idea-atom分解也被用于样本小说研究方向(Artiles等人,2026年). 我们重新将原子化用于科学测量。 ACC是外地一级的计数单位,所以我们对照他们自己的摘要来检查,并将其真相留给源文件.

blocks.en: 3.1 Atomic Contribution Claims
blocks.zh: 3.1 原子贡献索赔

blocks.en: Raw abstracts conflate multiple contributions, background context, and meta-language (“In this paper, we propose…”). Given a document d d , an LLM agent maps its abstract into a set of ACCs A d = { a 1 , … , a n } A_{d}=\{a_{1},\dots,a_{n}\} , each satisfying three constraints: atomicity (exactly one contribution-bearing proposition), decontextualization (pronouns resolved to named entities, meta-language removed), and falsifiability (a verifiable assertion). A typical ACC looks like “ TheoremLlama uses curriculum learning and block training techniques to train large language models for formal theorem proving ” Wang et al. (2024) . We deliberately operate on abstracts: they are the author-curated contribution summary, are uniformly available across all six years, and keep the pipeline to one cheap LLM pass per paper. The extractor is qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507 ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) (via OpenRouter, temperature 0.2) with a few-shot prompt that excludes background, motivation, and raw metric claims; the condensed prompt is in Appendix A and the full prompt in the released code. On EMNLP 2020–2025 the extractor yields 3.58 claims per abstract in 2020 and 4.01 in 2025; abstracts with no extractable contribution (3 of 751 in 2020) are excluded.
blocks.zh: 原始摘要汇集了多种贡献、背景背景和元语言(“在本文中,我们提议......”)。 在一个 d d 文档中, LLM 代理将其摘要映射到一组 A d = { a 1,..., a n} A_{d}=\{a_{1},\dots,a_{n}\}],分别满足三个制约因素:原子性(确切地说是一个有贡献的命题),解密化(代词解决了被命名的实体,元语言去除),以及易变性(一个可核实的断言). 一个典型的ACC看起来像“使用课程学习和阻断培训技术来培训大语言模型来证明正式定理......”Wang等人(2024年)。 我们特意使用摘要:这些摘要是作者确定的贡献摘要,在所有六年中都统一提供,并且每张纸都有一个廉价的LLM通行证。 提取器为qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507(Quen Team,2025)(通过OpenRouter,温度0.2),带有数发的提示,排除了背景,动机,以及原始的度量衡主张;缩合的提示在附录A中,释放代码中为全部提示. 在EMNLP 2020–2025上,提取器在2020年和2025年分别得出每份摘要3.58份和4.01份;没有可提取贡献的摘要(2020年751份中有3份)排除在外。

blocks.en: 3.2 Semantic Topology
blocks.zh: 3.2 语义地形学

blocks.en: We embed all claims with SPECTER2 ( Cohan et al., 2020 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) , a scientific encoder pretrained on citation relatedness, so claims about similar mechanisms land close together. We then reduce the vectors with UMAP ( McInnes et al., 2018 ) and cluster them with HDBSCAN ( McInnes et al., 2017 ) , as in BERTopic ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) , except that our unit is the claim rather than the abstract. Each cluster gets class-based TF-IDF descriptors — short (top-3, e.g., agents, action, web ) and extended (top-5) — and all 80 clusters additionally carry LLM-generated, author-reviewed readable names: a short name for map labels (e.g., Math & Logic Reasoning ) and a full name on the cluster page (e.g., Mathematical and Logical Reasoning in LLMs ), with the c-TF-IDF descriptor preserved in the claim card and cluster page.
blocks.zh: 我们把所有的主张都嵌入了SPECTER2(Cohan等人,2020年;Singh等人,2023年)中,这个科学编码器在引用关联性上事先受过训练,因此声称类似的机制接近一起着陆. 然后,我们用UMAP(McInnes等人,2018年)减少矢量,并将其与HDBSCAN(McInnes等人,2017年)集群,如在BERTopic(Grootendorst,2022年)中,除了我们的单位是主张而不是抽象. 每个集群都得到基于类的TF-IDF描述符——简称(Top-3,如代理,动作,网络)和扩展(Top-5),所有80个集群额外携带LLM生成,作者评审的可读名称:地图标签的简称(如数学和逻辑理性)和集群页面的全称(如LLMs中的数学和逻辑理性),C-TF-IDF描述符保留在索赔卡和集群页面中.

blocks.en: About 36% of claims remain unclustered “noise” — paper-specific contributions that have not (yet) become recurring field-level patterns; the share rises from 31–34% in 2020–2022 to 42% in 2025, consistent with the newest contributions having had the least time to consolidate. These are kept in the interface as a background layer rather than discarded. Retaining them is why the pipeline clusters by density (HDBSCAN): a method that must place every claim would put those with no field-level counterpart into the nearest cluster and dilute it. All hyperparameters are listed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 大约36%的索赔要求仍未归结为 " 噪音 " ——没有(尚未)成为经常性外地一级模式的纸张专用捐款;份额从2020-2022年的31-34 %上升到2025年的42 %,这与最新捐款最不需要巩固一致。 这些被保存在界面中作为背景层,而不是丢弃. 保留它们就是为什么输油管集群按密度(HDBSCAN):一种必须提出每一项索赔的方法将使那些没有实地对应物的人进入最近的集群并稀释它。 所有超参数均列于附录B。

blocks.en: 3.4 The Drift Inspector Frontend

blocks.en: The frontend (Figure 1 ) is a web application with five linked views. Every number it shows opens down to the claims and papers behind it.

blocks.en: • Map. A WebGL scatter (Plotly ScatterGL) of all 16,576 claims over a shared 2D UMAP projection. Year-filter buttons show any single year (2020–2025) or all at once; a color switch recolors every cluster by its prevalence trend (red = declining, green = growing), turning the map into a field-level drift heatmap; a Display menu toggles cluster names, the noise layer, and auto-fit. A search box highlights all claims whose text or source title contains a query substring (e.g., retrieval ) and ranks the matching clusters. Hovering a point shows the claim, source paper, year, cluster name, and prevalence trajectory; clicking pins this card with a link to the ACL Anthology. The legend isolates clusters (ctrl/cmd-click to combine). • Trends. A butterfly chart of the 2020 → \to 2025 document-frequency shift, per-year trajectories for any clusters the user selects (by clicking bars or sparklines), and a sparkline overview of all clusters. • Clusters. A per-cluster profile: its document frequency by year, its location in claim space, and all of its claims with links to source papers, exportable as CSV. • Compare. blocks.en: 3.5 Implementation and Availability

blocks.en:
The pipeline is Python (transformers, adapters, umap-learn, hdbscan, Plotly); every stage caches its artifact (claims CSV, embedding matrix, projection, cluster assignments), and all stochastic steps are seeded, so from the released claims the published clustering is exactly reproducible from configuration. Re-running the extraction reproduces aggregate rates but not individual claim strings, because LLM decoding is not reproducible run to run. Anybody can rerun the whole process end to end for a small API cost and negligible compute (§ 3.6 ). The frontend has no dependencies beyond a browser
and ships as a self-contained file in our GitHub repository . Code is released under the MIT license; the claim dataset under CC BY 4.0 (derived from openly licensed ACL Anthology abstracts, CC BY 4.0).
Appendix B gives the extractor and its decoding parameters, the embedding checkpoint, the clustering hyperparameters and the random seeds.

blocks.en: The same pipeline runs unchanged at corpus scale. On a research inference cluster we extracted the full ACL Anthology — 80,144 abstracts, 423 venues, 346,010 claims — with the cheaper gpt-oss-120b extractor ( ∼ \sim $40 at median commercial API prices; § 3.6 ), and we run a second live Drift Inspector over six *ACL main conferences (70k claims, 2018–2026). 2 2 2 https://hamyrappy.github.io/drift-inspector-acl/ There, cross-venue and cross-author questions become one-click cohort comparisons: Figure 3 contrasts ACL and COLING directly. On the EMNLP corpus this extractor swap preserves cluster validity and all 15 headline drift directions (§ 4.3 ). The human-aligned judge (§ 4.1 ) rates 300-claim samples from the scaled corpora at 96.7–99.7% Good (full EMNLP main track 98.7%, full ACL 99.7%, whole anthology 96.7%) against a 98.3% same-judge control on the validated corpus — overlapping 95% intervals throughout — and per-corpus judge reports ship with the data. blocks.en: 3.6 Scalability and Cost
blocks.zh: 3.6 可伸缩性和费用

blocks.en: The pipeline makes one LLM call per abstract, so extraction dominates the cost and grows linearly with the corpus (Table 1 ). Budgeting a new corpus is one multiplication: about $0.50 per thousand abstracts with gpt-oss-120b , so the full ACL Anthology — 80,144 abstracts — costs ∼ \sim $40 and runs overnight. A reasoning extractor such as Qwen3-235B-Thinking costs ∼ \sim $11 per thousand instead, because most of what you pay for is hidden reasoning, not the claims it returns. The cheap extractor preserves every headline drift direction (§ 4.3 ), so you do not need to pay it. Everything after extraction is two orders of magnitude cheaper and needs no accelerator: embedding, projection and clustering finish in well under an hour of laptop CPU at either scale, and the frontend needs no server.
blocks.zh: 管道使每个抽象的LLM调用一个LLM,因此提取占成本的主导,并随物體呈线性增长(表1). 编制新书目是乘法:每千份有gpt-oss-120b的书目约0.50美元,因此,完整的ACL Anthology——80,144份书目——成本为\sim 40美元,一夜之间运行。 Qune3-235B- Thinking等推理提取器花费了\\\sim每千美元11美元,因为你支付的大部分费用是隐藏推理,而不是它返回的索赔. 廉价的提取器保留了每个标题的漂移方向(§4.3),所以你不需要支付. 提取后的一切都是两个数量级的更便宜,不需要加速器:嵌入,投影和集群在两个尺度的1小时笔记本电脑CPU下完成,前端不需要服务器.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: Figure 4: Scientific drift in EMNLP (2020–2025) as measured by the system. Diverging bars show the change in paper-level document frequency (percentage points) for the top emerging and declining ACC clusters, annotated with 2020 and 2025 shares.

blocks.en: We evaluate the two stages that could corrupt the analysis: claim extraction quality and cluster validity. Both use the released EMNLP 2020–2025 ACC corpus: extraction quality on a stratified sample of extracted claims (with curated negative controls), and cluster validity on the 653 papers where our corpus overlaps the SToP gold taxonomy ( Rohatgi et al., 2023 ) . Robustness of the headline findings is evaluated separately (§ 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价可能破坏分析的两个阶段:索赔提取质量和集群有效性。 两者都使用公布的EMNLP 2020–2025 ACC accoraphic:在分级抽取的采样上提取质量(带有经过整理的负面控制),在653份文件上组群有效性,我们的文件与STOP金分类学(Rohatgi等人,2023年)重叠。 标题结论的健全性另行评估(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Human Validation of Claim Quality
blocks.zh: 4.1 索赔质量的人工验证

blocks.en: Three of the authors labeled 180 items (136 claims sampled from the extraction output, stratified by year, plus 44 curated invalid claims, which the annotators did not know about, as negative controls) as Good , Bad , or Unsure ; a claim is Good if it is atomic, self-contained, contribution-bearing, and faithful to the abstract. Inter-annotator agreement is high and robust to the Unsure convention (Fleiss’ κ = 0.844 \kappa=0.844 dropping Unsure , 0.76 0.76 folding it into Bad , 0.73 0.73 across three categories). On the 136 sampled claims the annotators rate 97.8%, 91.8%, and 90.5% as Good , and flag 44/44 planted negatives by 2-of-3 majority, so the labels are discriminating, not lenient. An independent LLM judge from a different vendor (Gemini vs. Qwen), separately prompted and blind to the human labels, matches the majority consensus with 94.5% accuracy ( κ = 0.863 \kappa=0.863 ) and flags 43 of 44 negatives, supporting its use for monitoring extraction on new corpora. The dominant failure modes are unsupported details and background-context extraction; the full protocol is released with the data.
blocks.zh: 其中三位作者将180件物品(136件索赔从提取产出中抽取,逐年分级,加上44件被解析无效的索赔,而注释者并不知道,作为负控制)标注为Good,Bad,或Usure;一项索赔如果是原子的,自成一体的,有贡献的,并且忠于抽象的,就是Good. 校对:Soup 在136个抽样中, 标注者认为97.8%、91.8%和90.5%为Good, 来自不同供应商的独立LLM法官(Gemini vs. Quen),单独煽动和无视人类标签,将多数共识与94.5%的精度匹配(ob = 0.863\kappa= 0.863),并在44个底片中标出43个,支持其在新公司上用于监测提取. 主导失败模式是无支持的细节和背景背景文本提取;完整协议随数据发布.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cluster Validity Against an External Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 4.2 对照外部分类学的集群有效性

blocks.en: We benchmark the clustering against the SToP gold taxonomy ( Rohatgi et al., 2023 ) on the 2020–2021 overlap (653 papers), comparing eight configurations: bag-of-words topic models (LDA, NMF), abstract-level neural clustering (BERTopic with SPECTER2 and MPNet encoders), sentence-level clustering (SentSPECTER), and claim-level clustering (ACC, ours), each optionally restricted to its 30 largest clusters. Table 2 summarizes the SToP-alignment results.
blocks.zh: 在2020-2021年重叠(653份文件)上,我们参照STOP黄金分类法(Rohatgi等人,2023年)将分类组合作为基准,比较了8种配置:包字专题模型(LDA,NMF),抽象层面神经分类(BERTOPIC与SPECTER2和MPNet编码器),句子层面分类(SentSPECTER)和债权层面分类(ACC,我们),每种组合可选限制在30个最大的集群。 表2汇总了战略目标调整结果。

blocks.en: Table 2: Alignment with the SToP taxonomy (2020–2021 subset, 653 papers). Purity and V-measure are computed on covered documents; LRAP and nDCG@1 via 5 × \times 5 repeated cross-validation, the topic-to-label map learned per fold on the training split. The step from abstract-level (BERTopic SPECTER2 , 0.324) to sentence-level (0.654) to claim-level (0.689) purity shows input granularity matters more than encoder choice. Full table with intrinsic metrics and coverage in the released artifacts.
blocks.zh: 表2:与STOP分类法一致(2020-2021子集,653篇论文). 在覆盖的文件中计算纯度和V度度; LIRP和nDCG@1通过 5 ×\times 5 重复的交叉验证,在训练分页上每折叠所学的话题对标签地图。 从抽象层次(BERTOPIC SPECTER2, 0.324)到句子层次(0.654)到主张层次(0.689)的纯度步骤,显示输入的颗粒性比编码器的选择更重要。 完整的表格,包含内在的衡量尺度和所释放的文物的覆盖范围。

blocks.en: Coverage differs by construction: LDA/NMF/BERTopic are scored with a soft document–topic distribution (BERTopic via approximate_distribution ) that assigns mass even to abstracts HDBSCAN treats as outliers ( ∼ {\sim} 100% coverage), whereas ACC keeps a hard HDBSCAN partition with noise excluded, leaving all-noise papers uncovered (83.9%). The coverage-robust V-measure, LRAP, nDCG@1, and top-30 rows neutralize this, and ACC leads or ties throughout. The soft step was required for BERTopic, because under equally hard assignment it leaves 22–26% of abstracts as outliers vs. 16% for ACC. The hard partition is therefore not what costs coverage: the noise fraction follows from the input granularity. A soft ACC assignment remains a natural extension.
blocks.zh: LDA/NMF/BERTopic的覆盖范围因构造而异:LDA/NMF/BERTopic的得分是软文件的分布(BERTopic通过近似_分布),它甚至将质量分配到摘要HDBSCAN(Q{\sim}100%的覆盖),而ACC则保留硬HDBSCAN分区,排除噪音,使全噪音文件被揭开(83.9%)。 覆盖力强的V度量、LIRP、nDCG@1和前30行消除了这种情况,ACC领导或联系贯穿全局。 BERTOPIC要求采取软步骤,因为根据同样硬性的任务,它留下22-26%的摘要作为外部数据,而ACC则需要16%。 因此,硬分区不是成本覆盖的方面:噪音分量来自输入颗粒。 行政协调会的软任务仍然是自然的延伸。

blocks.en: 4.3 Robustness of Headline Findings
blocks.zh: 4.3 头条结论的有力性

blocks.en: Our headline finding is the set of 15 cluster-level prevalence shifts in Figure 4 . Six reasons could explain the pattern without the field having changed: sampling noise, a two-snapshot artifact, the encoder, the cluster-matching rule, the extractor, and the clustering hyperparameters. Each test below tracks the same quantity, the sign of the 2020 → \to 2025 shift.
blocks.zh: 我们的头条发现是图4中的15个集群级流行率变化。 有六个原因可以解释这个模式,但字段没有改变:取样噪声,一个双斜射的文物,编码器,集群比对规则,提取器,以及集群超参数. 下方的每次试验都追踪到同样数量,即2020~~~~到2025年班次的标志.

blocks.en: Sampling. All 15 shifts are significant under a two-proportion z z -test (13 at p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and their bootstrap 95% CIs on Δ D ​ F \Delta_{DF} (2,000 paper-level resamples) exclude zero.
blocks.zh: 采样. 在双比例的z - test(13 at p < 0.001 p < 0.001)下,所有15个班次都是显著的,他们的靴套95%的CI在QQ D F\Delta=DF}(2,000纸层复标)上排除0.

blocks.en: Two snapshots. Trajectories are largely monotone across the six years (parsing runs 5.1 → 3.2 → 1.6 → 1.6 → 0.8 → 0.1 5.1\to 3.2\to 1.6\to 1.6\to 0.8\to 0.1 % of papers; Figure 6 ), so the shifts are not an artifact of comparing the two endpoints.
blocks.zh: 两个快照。 轨迹在6年中基本上都是单调的(parsing runs 5.1 → 3.2 → 1.6 → 1.6 → 0.8 → 0.1 5.1\to 3.2\to 1.6\to 1.1 %的论文;图6),因此转折不是比较两个端点的文物.

blocks.en: Encoder. We re-embed and re-cluster the same claims with nine alternative representations under an identical UMAP/HDBSCAN pipeline: eight other sentence and document encoders (SciNCL, SPECTER1, MPNet, MiniLM, BGE-large/small, E5-large, Nomic) and a non-neural TF-IDF + SVD baseline. Cluster counts and noise fractions stay in the same range (55–116 clusters, 31–53% noise), and every representation preserves the sign for at least 11 of the 15 headline clusters (median 14/15; TF-IDF + SVD 12/15); a cluster in an alternative clustering is identified with a headline cluster by best-Jaccard overlap of their claim sets. Per-encoder results are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 编码器。 我们重新将同样的索赔与9项备选陈述合并,放在一个相同的UMAP/HDBSCAN管道下:另外8句和文件编码器(ScinCL、SPECTER1、MPNet、MiniLM、BGE大/小、E5大、Nomic)和一个非神经TF-IDF+SVD基线。 集群计数和噪声分数保持不变(55-116组,31-53%的噪声),每个表示值至少保留15个标题集群中的11个(中间数14/15;TF-IDF + SVD 12/15);另类集群中的一个集群通过它们的索赔组合的最好-雅克卡重叠来识别一个标题集群. 每个编码器的结果载于附录C。

blocks.en: Matching rule. Recomputing all signs under two sign-blind alternatives to best-Jaccard matching, union overlap and weighted claim image, never lowers a per-encoder count.
blocks.zh: 匹配规则。 将所有标志在两个标志盲选项下重置,以取代最佳-Jaccard匹配,联盟重叠和加权要求图像,永远不降低每编码器计数.

blocks.en: Extractor. Re-extracting with gpt-oss-120b , a different model family that yields 4.6 claims per paper against 3.7, preserves all 15 signs and keeps claim-level clustering ahead of every abstract-level baseline on SToP (purity 0.638, V-measure 0.541).

blocks.en: 5 Case Study: EMNLP 2020–2025
blocks.zh: 5 案例研究:EMNLP 2020-2025

blocks.en: Running the system on 4,488 EMNLP papers (748 per year across 2020–2025) yields the field-level picture in Figure 4 . Classic task clusters lose document-frequency share: parsing falls most steeply ( − 4.9 -4.9 pp, − 97 % -97\% relative), while machine translation, dialogue, and question answering each shrink by 3.7 3.7 – 4.4 4.4 pp. LLM-era clusters grow in their place: multimodal and vision-language modeling gains + 9.1 +9.1 pp ( 3.1 × 3.1\times its 2020 prevalence) and agents rise more than tenfold ( 10.3 × 10.3\times ), with mathematical reasoning, large-model tuning and inference, and a newly emergent LLM reasoning-behavior cluster making up the rest of the growth. Qualitatively, the declining tasks have not vanished: claim search shows their residual claims thinning and dispersing into the noise layer and neighbouring clusters rather than re-forming as standalone contributions — fragmentation that paper- or keyword-level counts cannot distinguish from disappearance. Figure 4 annotates all twenty clusters with their 2020 and 2025 shares.
blocks.zh: 在4 488份EMNLP论文上运行系统(整个2020-2025年每年748份),在图4中得出了实地情况。 经典任务集群失去了文件频率份额:解析率下降幅度最大(-4.9-4.9页,-97%-97),而机器翻译、对话、提问回答每场收缩3.7-3.7 — 4.4页。 LLM时代集群正在增长:多模式和视觉语言模型增益+9.1+9.1页(3.1 × 3.1 乘以其2020年的流行),代理商上升了十倍以上(10.3 × 10.3\时),数学推理、大模型调和推论以及新兴的 LLM 推理-行为集群构成增长的其余部分。 从质量上讲,不断减少的任务并没有消失:索赔查询显示其剩余索赔稀释和分散到噪音层和邻近集群,而不是作为独立贡献重新形成——纸面或关键词一级的统计无法区别于消失。 图4列出了所有20个集群及其2020年和2025年的份额。

blocks.en: 5.1 Use Cases
blocks.zh: 5.1 使用案例

blocks.en: Is this area still growing? A researcher weighing a retrieval project wants to know whether the area is expanding before committing to it. Typing retrieval into the Map search highlights every claim whose text or source title matches, and ranks clusters by how many of those matches they hold. The top-ranked cluster’s trend page shows its share of papers rising from 0.7% in 2020 to 3.3% in 2025, and the ranking places that growth in dense-retrieval and LLM-adjacent clusters rather than in classic IR. Each point on the trajectory opens the claim behind it and links to its paper.
blocks.zh: 这个区域还在增长吗? 一位衡量检索项目的研究人员想知道该地区是否在扩大,然后再承诺。 在地图搜索中打入检索,突出显示文本或源标题匹配的每个请求,并按其中有多少匹配进行分组排序。 排名最高的集群的趋势页面显示其论文比例从2020年的0.7%上升到2025年的3.3 %,排名将增长置于密集检索和LLM相邻集群而不是经典IR. 轨迹上的每一点都打开它背后的主张,并与它的论文链接.

blocks.en: What does a venue publish? Compare takes two cohorts and ranks clusters by their gap in paper share. Figure 3 contrasts ACL with COLING: COLING keeps a stronger classic-NLP profile (embeddings, aspect-based sentiment, NER, event extraction), while ACL leans toward efficient reasoning, multilingual LLMs and vision–language evaluation. A cohort can also be an author or a keyword-defined subsample, so bert against llm (Figure 5 ) or two research groups. The over time mode makes the comparison diachronic.
blocks.zh: 一个会场出版什么? 比较需要两个组群,并按其在纸张份额上的差额排列组群。 图3将ACL与COLING对比:COLING保持了更强的经典NLP配置(嵌入式,基于侧面的情绪,NER,事件提取),而ACL则倾向于高效的推理,多语言的LLM和愿景-语言评价. 组群也可以是作者或关键词定义的子样本,因此bert针对llm(图5)或两个研究组. 随时间推移的模式使得比较具有二亚环.

blocks.en: What is emerging, and what is declining? Trends ranks every cluster by its 2020 → \to 2025 shift with bootstrap intervals, so both ends appear in one view: LLM reasoning behaviour and vision–language modeling at the growing end, syntactic parsing ( − 4.9 -4.9 pp, − 97 % -97\% relative) at the other. Because prevalence counts papers with at least one claim in a cluster, a topic that is still discussed but no longer contributed looks different from one that has disappeared: claim search shows the residual parsing claims scattered across the noise layer and neighbouring clusters instead of forming a cluster of their own. A narrower term behaves the same way. Searching humor puts almost all of its matches in the noise layer, each still linked to its source paper.
blocks.zh: 正在出现什么,正在下降什么? 趋势到2020年 ~\ 至 2025 年 的变迁, 双端都出现在一种观点中: LLM 推理行为和视觉 - 语言模型在增长端, 合成解析( - 4.9 - 4.9页, − 97% - 97 - ===)在另一端。 由于流行性将至少一个主张放在一个集群中的文件计算在内,这个仍在讨论但不再有贡献的专题看起来与已经消失的专题不同: 主张搜索显示分散在噪音层和邻近集群的剩余诉求解析,而不是形成自己的集群. 狭义的名词行为也一样. 搜索幽默将它几乎所有的火柴都放在噪音层,每个火柴都仍然与它的源文件相连.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Compare view, over time mode: yearly topic mix (top clusters, % of cohort claims) for the bert cohort (197 papers) vs. llm / large language model (3,253 papers): the residual bert agenda concentrates in claim verification and biomedical NLP, while the llm cohort shifts toward vision–language modeling and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 图5:比较观点,时间模式:伯特组的年度专题组合(顶级组群,占组群诉求的%) (197篇论文)与wllm/大语言模式(3,253篇论文):其余的伯特议程集中在索赔核实和生物医学NLP上,而wllm组群则转向愿景-语言模式和效率。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Drift Inspector turns a validated claim-extraction pipeline into an interactive instrument for watching a field reorganize itself, its trends reflecting what papers assert they add rather than the vocabulary of their motivation. The system is fully open (MIT code, CC BY data) and corpus-agnostic: any venue with abstracts can be mapped in one pass. Next step is implementing a hierarchical theme system aggregating clusters into navigable super-themes.
blocks.zh: 漂流检查员将经过验证的索要程序转变为一个互动工具,用于观察实地重组本身,其趋势反映的是文件所断言的内容,而不是其动机的词汇。 该系统是完全开放的(MIT代码,CC BY数据)和实体-不可知论:任何带有摘要的会场都可以通过一个通道映射. 下一步是实施分级主题系统,将集群组合成可导航的超主题。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The analysis relies on abstracts, which omit technical nuance and negative results, and some contributions surface only in the paper body. All validated results are on a single venue (EMNLP): the larger extractions we release (six *ACL venues; the full anthology) are only LLM-judge-monitored, not human-revalidated, so their per-cluster numbers warrant more caution. The pipeline rests on an LLM extractor that can introduce errors (hallucination, under/over-splitting), mitigated but not eliminated by schema and human validation and an aligned LLM judge; human validation was by the authors on 136 claims, so agreement partly reflects shared training, and the negatives are curated corruptions rather than sampled natural errors. Clustering depends on UMAP/HDBSCAN hyperparameters and the embedding model; headline drift directions are stable under bootstrap resampling, eight encoders, and a lexical representation, but cluster boundaries and labels may vary, and drift statistics are descriptive, not causal.
blocks.zh: 分析依赖于摘要,这些摘要省略了技术细微和负结果,一些贡献只在纸质中露面. 所有验证的结果都在一个地点(EMNLP):我们发布的更大的提取(六个*ACL地点;完整的解剖学)只是LLM法官监测的,而不是人类再验证的,因此它们的每组数值得更加谨慎. 管道依赖于一个LLM提取器,它可以引入错误(卤化,在/过度分享下),通过计划与人类验证和一致的LLM法官减轻但未能消除;人类验证是作者对136项主张的验证,因此协议部分反映了共同的训练,底片是被整理的腐败而非抽样的自然错误. 集群取决于UMAP/HDBSCAN超参数和嵌入模型;头条漂移方向稳定在靴带重印下,有8个编码器,以及一个词汇代表,但集群边界和标签可能有所不同,漂移统计是描述性的,而不是因果的.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The system analyzes publicly available ACL Anthology abstracts (CC BY 4.0) and involves no private data. The main risk is misinterpretation: cluster prevalence reflects sampling, extraction, and clustering choices and should be read as a descriptive signal about abstracts, not a verdict on subfields’ scientific value: a decline in standalone parsing contributions does not mean parsing is solved or worthless. We document all parameters and release all artifacts to keep the measurement inspectable.
blocks.zh: 该系统分析公开提供的ACL人类学摘要(CC BY 4.0),不涉及私人数据. 主要的风险是误解:集群普遍性反映了采样、提取和集群选择,应当理解为关于摘要的描述性信号,而不是对子域科学价值的判断:独立解析贡献的下降并不意味着解析或无价值。 我们记录所有参数 并释放所有文物 保持测量检查。

blocks.zh: 附录A 采掘和法官提示(汇总)

blocks.en: The extractor returns JSON {"claims": [{"text": ...}]} . Core instruction (few-shot examples omitted; full prompts in the repository):
blocks.zh: 提取器返回 JSON {"要求" : [{"文本":...]]]. 核心指令( 图片示例省略; 存储器中的全部提示) :

blocks.en: Task. Extract Atomic Contribution Claims (ACCs) from NLP paper titles and abstracts — faithful, self-contained, atomic, contribution-bearing propositions about what the paper introduces, proposes, evaluates, demonstrates, or establishes. Include: new methods, models, objectives, training/inference procedures; new datasets, benchmarks, resources, tools, evaluation setups; empirical findings and analyses established by the paper. Exclude: background, motivation, related work, future work, release logistics; vague problem statements; prior-work claims; raw metric-only claims. Rules: one proposition per claim; no facts absent from the title/abstract; resolve pronouns and vague references; no meta-language (“this paper”, “we”); mid-level granularity; no raw numbers; no near-duplicates; if unsure, omit; usually 1–5 claims, empty list if none. Self-validation. Silently check every candidate against: contribution-bearing, atomic, faithful, decontextualized; discard failures.
blocks.zh: 任务. 从NLP纸面标题和摘要中摘录原子贡献索赔——关于该文件提出、提议、评价、证明或确定的忠实、自足、原子和有贡献的建议。 包括:新方法、模型、目标、培训/参考程序;新的数据集、基准、资源、工具、评价设置;文件确定的经验结论和分析。 不包括:背景,动机,相关工作,未来工作,释放物流;模糊的问题陈述;前期工作索赔;原始的仅计量索赔. 规则:每件索赔一个命题;标题/摘要没有遗漏任何事实;解决代词和模糊的提法;没有元语言(“本文”,“我们”);中层颗粒性;没有原始数字;没有近似重复;如果不确定,省略;通常1至5件索赔,如果没有空清单。 自我验证. 悄悄地检查每个候选人:有贡献的,原子的,忠实的,解密的;抛弃失败的.

blocks.en: The independent LLM judge receives one candidate claim with its title and abstract and labels it Good / Bad / Unsure with a main-issue category ( background_context , unsupported , too_vague , not_self_contained , not_contribution , overgeneralized , mixed_claims ); it is prompted separately from the extractor and never sees human labels.
blocks.zh: 独立的LLM法官收到一份候选人申请,其标题和摘要并标注为Good/Bad/ 不确定有主问题类别(背景_context ,不支持,太_vague ,不自定义,不自定义,不自贡献,过于概括,混合_主张);它与提取器分开驱动,从未看到人类的标签.

blocks.en: Human-validation sampling. We stratify the 180-item sample by year (seed 42; 54/18/18/18/18/54 across 2020–2025). Of these, 136 are claims from the 16,576-claim output, at most one per paper, and 44 are negative controls: invalid claims we built by injecting an unsupported detail, recasting motivation as a contribution, or over-generalizing. Annotators see only the title, abstract, and claim, and never learn which items are controls.
blocks.zh: 人体验证采样. 我们逐年划分180项样本(见42;2020-2025年全年的54/18/18/18/18/54)。 其中,136项索赔来自16,576项索赔的产出,最多每份文件一份,44项是负面控制:我们通过注入无佐证的细节,将动机重塑为贡献,或者过度概括而构建的无效索赔. 注释者只看到标题,抽象,和主张,从来不会知道哪些项目是控制.

blocks.en: Table 3 re-embeds and re-clusters the 16,576 claims with nine alternative representations under the identical UMAP/HDBSCAN pipeline (§ 4.3 ). ARI is measured against the canonical SPECTER2 clustering and SToP purity on the 653-paper overlap of Table 2 ; signs are matched by best Jaccard, which is sign-blind by construction. Recomputing all 9 × 15 9\times 15 signs under two alternative criteria never lowers a per-encoder count. Every representation preserves at least 11/15 signs, so the drift is not an artifact of the encoder, and SPECTER2’s top purity is why we make it canonical.
